title: Liouville type theorems for fully nonlinear elliptic equations with superlinear growth in gradient
summary: This article investigates positive supersolutions of the fully nonlinear elliptic system \[ \begin{cases} -\mathcal{M}_{λ,Λ}^{+}(D^{2}u)+|\nabla u|^{q} \geqλ_{1}f_{1}(v)~~\text{in}~~\mathbb{R}^{n}\setminus B_{R_0},\\ -\mathcal{M}_{λ,Λ}^{+}(D^{2}v)+|\nabla v|^{q} \geqλ_{2}f_{2}(u)~~\text{in}~~\mathbb{R}^{n}\setminus B_{R_0}, \end{cases} \] where $q>1,λ_{1},λ_{2}>0,$ and the nonlinearities exhibit power-type behaviour either near the origin or at infinity.
